## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      3 reseñas recientes mencionan precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 22 ago 2026 - 9 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _CyndySmith_, 9 sept 2026, 1/5: "I signed up and paid £16, then tried to do meal planning and I need to pay another £20/month. Seriously?"
            2. _Leemiz_, 22 ago 2026, 1/5: "Every three clicks on the app prompts it asking me to buy premium. No. I don’t want it and clicking so all the time is very very annoying"
            3. _timbaa88_, 1 sept 2026, 5/5: "I accidentally purchased the one-year subscription instead of the monthly option. Unfortunately, I only noticed my mistake when I checked the charge on my online banking account, less than 24 hours after making the purchase. I contacted customer support immediately and requested a refund so that I could repurchase the subscription using the monthly option instead. Unfortunately, my refund request was denied. I’m disappointed because this was a genuine mistake, reported very quickly, and I wasn’t asking to cancel my subscription altogether—I simply wanted the opportunity to switch to the monthly plan. I feel that a little more flexibility and understanding from customer support would have made a big difference. I don’t want to rate the app itself based on a bad experience caused by my own mistake, as I understand that I selected the wrong subscription option. However, considering I noticed the mistake and requested a refund in less than 24 hours, I feel they could have honoured the refund and allowed me to repurchase the monthly subscription instead."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      5 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 19 jul 2026 - 11 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _cheezeluvr77_, 9 sept 2026, 1/5: "The app was working an hour ago and now I can't even log in. It's saying account not found. I was paying for premium too. Also several MFP "help" links make you log in to send a message so I have zero way of fixing the issue"
            2. _Red Sox Mania_, 8 sept 2026, 1/5: "They ruined everything that was good about the app. It’s unusable. Really sad they let AI code and manage support and tell them what people like. I’m sure soon enough they will announce it’s shutting down."
            3. _LoriLins64_, 16 ago 2026, 1/5: "Note: I am a paid user, and have been using MFP for a couple of years now, quite happily. But this new update is absolutely horrific, the worst I’ve ever seen. They took a very user-friendly app and made it ridiculously unusable. What used to be very simple is now a frustrating exercise and having to navigate through many screens and not being able to even see your macros, or how many you have left. I actually hate it. I wish there was a way to refer to the previous version. As soon as I find a replacement, I will be canceling my subscription and deleting this monstrosity from my phone."
<!--/ir-theme-->
